_note: Pictures behind the alarm editor's game and sound tiles (UX.7, the user 2026-10-02: AI-made, cute pastel anime, filling the tile with the name on a pill). One shared style so the ten match. Built files go to app/src/main/assets/tiles/<id>.webp. Night versions (the app's night look) use nightStyle and build to <id>_night.webp; a tile without one shows its day picture.
style: Cute pastel anime-style illustration for a mobile game button background. Soft rounded shapes, gentle cel shading, bright but soft pastel colours on a light cream background, warm morning light. Wide banner composition: the main objects sit on the left and right, with calmer, simpler space in the centre where a label will go. No people, no characters, no words, no logos, no watermark text.
nightStyle: Cute pastel anime-style illustration of a few small props floating in empty space, for a mobile game button background at night. The props are isolated objects that float freely, each with a soft glow and gentle cel shading; a few tiny twinkling stars float around them. The background is completely plain: a smooth gradient from deep navy to indigo and nothing else. Wide banner layout: props on the left and right, the centre left empty and dark for a label. The scene contains only the props and the plain background: no landscape, no trees, no forest, no plants growing from the ground, no ground, no floor, no table, no horizon, no sky scenery, no clouds, no moon, no buildings, no room, no people, no characters, no words, no logos.
